seen: The lighthouse is small in frame. A single grey beam appears in frame 3, passing through the house. No ringed lens is visible around the flame and there is no second beam.
problem: The lens is not visible and only one beam appears, and it cuts through the house. Show a ringed lens appearing around the flame and two long bright beams going out past the house.
text: So you add a lens, invented in 1822, that bends it into one beam.
